why: This file was a hand-written snapshot of the 2026-08 Vantage gold desk (EUR 633.89, 5.5% sizing, four XAUUSD breakout sleeves). Nothing regenerated it, so for two months it read as authoritative state while describing an account and a book the desk no longer runs. A state file that no organ writes is a claim, not a measurement; it is retired rather than refreshed by hand.
